prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: wide horizontal in-game story illustration, no words or labels.
Primary request: a polished realistic painterly illustration of watertight bulkheads inside an ancient Chinese wooden seagoing ship, with the same sunlit amber wood grain, finely detailed handworked timber, cinematic natural light and rich material depth as the reference image. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: do not change the first-chapter artwork and do not repeat its coins, mirror or shipwright scene.
Scene: View from slightly above and the side into a large wooden ship hull at a sunny coastal shipyard. A neatly cut-away near-side hull wall reveals three consecutive compartments separated by full-width transverse wooden bulkhead walls, each wall meeting the curved hull bottom and side walls continuously, closed and fitted tight down to the keel. Beautiful broad timber planks, believable caulked seams, curved ribs, warm oak and amber wood in soft late-morning sunlight. The far hull side remains in place. The near outer wall is opened as an illustrative cutaway so the reader can clearly inspect the interior.
Visual explanation: only the leftmost compartment contains shallow blue-green water from a small damaged opening in its outer hull. The other two compartments have clearly visible dry timber floors. The separating bulkhead fully contains that water, with no holes or doorway underneath it, no water leaking into the next compartment. Thin subtle turquoise caulking accent follows the bottom and side edges where the nearest dividing wall joins the hull, to match the existing story's mention of cyan seam edges. The sea and shipyard may appear softly in the distant background, but the main focus is the wooden compartments, not the horizon.
Composition: widescreen landscape approximately 2.2:1, show the complete cutaway hull segment and all three compartments with breathing room around the edges; clear foreground-to-background depth, readable even at small UI sizes. No people are needed. Warm timber palette with restrained sea-green water and caulking accent.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no typography, no arrows, no infographic boxes, no watermark. No coins, no copper mirror, no giant waves. Keep the divider wall continuous down to the hull floor; show ONLY ONE wet compartment and adjacent DRY compartments.
